svg.aria-label: A thin vertical line splits the image. On the left, two idle workers stand by a stop sign showing a ballot slipping into a ballot box, in front of a half-built, dark data center with a frozen crane, labeled paused. On the right, a larger proud robot holding a bolt stands beside a workbench where a smaller copy of itself sits, with a speed gauge nearly full and a label reading twice as fast.
